EMBED | Original PNG bytes are stored inside the document. Exact 48x32-cell
footprint; no external file is needed after save.
DITHER | Prepared line art keeps tonal threshold behavior at 96x64 quadrants.
Deterministic and source-like, but fine tone can become pattern.
SIMPLIFY | Prepared line art is processed on a 384x256 working canvas (4x each
axis), then reduced to the final 96x64 lattice. Intentional approximation, not
